howto.what: 装上后，Claude能自动管理Anthropic管理后台的API密钥、使用量、工作区和组织设置。
howto.when: 当连接Rube MCP并完成Anthropic Admin认证后，通过搜索工具再执行操作时触发。

say.text: 列出我所有的Anthropic API密钥。
say.note: Claude会搜索相关工具并返回密钥列表。

say.text: 查看当前工作区的用量统计。
say.note: Claude调用工具获取使用数据。

say.text: 更新组织设置，更改名称。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automate Anthropic Admin tasks: manage API keys, usage, workspaces, and organization settings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when connected to Rube MCP with Anthropic Admin authentication, and you search for tools then execute operations.

say_en.text: List all my Anthropic API keys.
say_en.note: Claude searches tools and returns the key list.

say_en.text: View usage statistics for the current workspace.
say_en.note: Claude calls tools to fetch usage data.

say_en.text: Update organization settings and change the name.
